title: Yogurt-Kissed Uruguayan Clotted-Cream Hash
description: A twist on the classic Uruguayan dish, this yogurt-kissed clotted-cream hash is perfect for a quick and easy breakfast. The addition of yogurt adds a tangy flavor and a touch of coolness to the warm clotted cream.

ingredients.name: Clotted cream
ingredients.notes: Extra clotted cream adds a rich and creamy texture to the dish.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.notes: Greek yogurt provides a tangy flavor and a touch of coolness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Diced chorizo
ingredients.notes: Uruguayan-style chorizo adds a spicy kick to the dish.

ingredients.name: Diced onion
ingredients.notes: Caramelized onion adds a sweet and savory flavor to the dish.

ingredients.name: Diced bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Green bell pepper adds a crunchy texture and a touch of sweetness to the dish.

ingredients.name: Talavera plate
ingredients.notes: Serve in a stone bowl dolsot, garnished with cilantro and a dollop of yogurt.

instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced chorizo and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced onion and cook until caramelized, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the clotted cream and cook until heated through.
Stir in the yogurt and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve in a talavera plate, garnished with cilantro and a dollop of yogurt.
